p: We collect only what the app needs: your name, email, date of birth and your Room records.
Only approved members of your Room see its records. Your email is shown only to Room Admins.
Free app with small ads. Your expenses, receipts and Room details are never shared with advertisers. Mess Manager does not hold or move money.
You can read this policy anytime in the app, download your data, or delete your account.
Mess Manager is provided by Uyoon Tech Solutions, a unit of Unifair Trading Pvt. Ltd., India ("we"). This policy explains what personal data the app uses, why, and the choices you have.
Mess Manager is a shared notebook for the expenses of a group (a "Room"). It does not hold, send or receive money.
Account: your name, email address, date of birth (to confirm you are 18 or older), password (stored only as a secure hash), language and settings.
Room data: Rooms you create or join, expenses, splits, settlements, payment records, receipts and payment proofs you upload, disputes, Need Requests and the history of changes.
Device data: notification tokens, basic technical information needed to run the app, and — in the phone app — the advertising identifier used by the ad network (see Ads).
To run the service you asked for: keeping your Rooms' records, calculating settlements, sending notifications and statements (contract).
To keep the service safe and fix problems (legitimate interest).
To show ads that keep the app free, only with the choices described below (consent where the law requires it).
Only approved members of a Room see that Room's records. Your email address is visible only to the Room's Admins; other members see your display name.
We never share financial data, receipts, Room names or expense details with advertisers, and never use them to target ads.
We share your data with authorities only when the law requires it, for example a court order.

We use: Supabase (database, sign-in and file storage), an email service for statements and account emails, Google AdMob for ads in the phone app, and Expo / Google Firebase for push notifications. They process data only on our instructions. [Hosting region and list to be confirmed.]

Room records are kept for two complete calendar months after the cycle they belong to is settled, then deleted from the live database and removed from backups within 30 days. Seven days before, every member receives the records by email; the emailed PDF is your permanent copy.

When you delete your account, your sign-in stops immediately; your records stay read-only for two months only for your former Rooms' accounts and disputes, then everything linked to you, including your email address, is deleted.
In the app you can download all your data (PDF/JSON), correct your profile, switch ads to non-personalised, and delete your account. Account deletion is also available on our website without the app.
You can also write to our Grievance Officer: Khizar Yar Khan, support@utplgroup.com. We answer within 30 days.

The free phone app shows small banner ads, never on screens about payments, settlements, disputes, sign-in or account deletion. Where the law requires it (for example the EEA, UK and Switzerland) you are asked before any personalised ad. Everywhere else you can switch to non-personalised ads at any time in Preferences.
Payments for Mess Manager Plus are processed by Google Play; we receive only whether your subscription is active and until when, never your card or bank details.

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest; every table is protected so that only Room members can read it; files are stored privately and opened with short-lived links; the history of changes cannot be edited by anyone.
Mess Manager is for people aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
If we change this policy in an important way we will ask you to accept the new version in the app.
Mess Manager is a shared notebook for a Room's expenses. It never holds or moves money.
What members write is an informal record between them, not a legal contract. Each person is responsible for what they enter.
Be honest and respectful. Don't upload anything illegal, abusive or someone else's private data.
The app is free with small ads and keeps improving, so features can change. We tell you in the app before important changes to these Terms.
Mess Manager is a record-keeping tool only. It does not hold, transfer or process money and is not a bank, wallet or payment service.

Expenses, shares, settlements and payments recorded in the app are informal notes among Room members. They are not a legally binding contract or a guarantee that anyone owes or has paid money. The app does the arithmetic, but it cannot check that what users enter is correct.

The app is continually improving. Some features may not always work as planned, and we may change, limit or stop a feature. Before we close the service we will give notice so you can download your records.

You must be 18 or older, give true information about yourself, and be allowed to use such a service under the laws that apply to you. You may not open a new account if we closed your earlier one for breaking these Terms.
You are responsible for keeping your password and phone secure. Tell us at once if you think someone else has used your account.
Users and Room Admins are solely responsible for the accuracy of what they enter and for settling money among themselves. Admins decide who joins their Room and confirm payments.
You are responsible for everything you add: names, descriptions, comments, photos, receipts and payment proofs. Do not add anything that:
• you have no right to share, or that exposes another person's private information (for example ID cards, bank details or phone numbers) to harass, blackmail or target them;
• is false or misleading, including pretending to be someone else;
• is obscene, sexual, abusive, threatening or hateful towards any person or group, for any reason such as religion, caste, race, nationality, gender, disability or age;
• is illegal or promotes illegal activity, or is spam, a pyramid scheme or other promotion.
We do not check every entry, but we may remove content or limit an account that breaks these rules or the law.
Uyoon Tech Solutions is not a party to any dispute between members. The in-app dispute feature is a convenience only.
Records are kept for two complete calendar months only. The emailed PDF statement is your own copy; we have no obligation to keep data longer.

Use the app only for its purpose and within the law. No illegal transactions, fraud, money laundering, gambling pools, harassment or abuse, and no attempts to break, overload or get around the app's security.
If an account misuses the service, we may suspend or close it. Where it is safe and lawful, we will tell you why and give you a chance to respond and to download your records.
The service is provided "as is" and "as available". We do our best, but we do not promise that it will be error-free or always available.

To the maximum extent permitted by law we are not liable for losses caused by what users enter, by disagreements between members, by user error, network failure or third-party services, or for indirect losses. Nothing in these Terms limits liability that the law does not allow us to limit.

sections.h: Free plan and Mess Manager Plus
p: Mess Manager is free to use. On the free plan an account can be in up to 2 Rooms at a time, counting Rooms it created, Rooms it joined and join requests still waiting for approval; Rooms you left or were removed from do not count. Mess Manager Plus is a monthly or yearly subscription through Google Play that removes ads on all your devices and raises the limit to 10 Rooms. Price, renewal and cancellation are handled by Google Play under its terms; you can cancel anytime in Google Play and keep Plus for the period you paid for. Refunds follow Google Play's policy. If Plus ends while you are in more than 2 Rooms, you keep those Rooms and all their records, but you cannot create or join another one until you are below the limit.
These Terms are governed by the laws of India; courts of Indore (Madhya Pradesh) have jurisdiction. Your mandatory local consumer rights are not affected.

If any part of these Terms is found invalid, the rest still applies and the invalid part is replaced by a valid one as close as possible to its purpose. If we do not enforce a term at once, we do not give up the right to enforce it later. These Terms and the Privacy Policy are the whole agreement between you and us about the app.
We may change these Terms. We will tell you in the app first, and important changes need your fresh acceptance before you continue.
